deliverables.summary: Full implementation of ICircuitBreaker with FSM 3-state (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN), sliding window 60s (10 sub-buckets), fail-fast < 1ms on OPEN, and probe execution in HALF_OPEN

Consensus Engine featuring Bully/Raft-lite Leader Election (> 3s coordinator timeout), Tiered Quorum (CFT Majority > 50% vs BFT Supermajority >= ceil((2N+1)/3) > 66.7%), and Deadlock Detector with DFS cycle detection and lowest-priority lock preemption
28 comprehensive unit tests covering FSM lifecycle, sliding window thresholds, leader election, tiered quorum, deadlock cycle detection, and boundary cases
